test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The curved surface area of a cone is (3432)/(7) cm² and its radius is 12 cm. What is the radius of a sphere whose volume is 1.2 times the volume of the cone? (Take π = (22)/(7) )
solution:
**Given**

Curved surface area of a cone = (3432)/(7) cm2 and its radius is 12 cm

**Formula used**

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

where r and l are radius and slant height of the cone respectively

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr²h

**Calculation**

πrl = (3432/7)

⇒ (22/7) × 12 × l = (3432/7)

⇒ l = (3432)/(22 × 12)

⇒ l = 13

h = √l² - r²

⇒ h = √(13)² - (12)²

⇒ h = √169 - 144

⇒ h = √25

⇒ h = 5

Volume of sphere = 1.2 × volume of cone

⇒ (4/3) × π × r³ = 1.2 × (1/3) × π × 12² × h

⇒ 4r³ = 1.2 × 12 × 12 × 5

⇒ r³ = (1.2 × 12 × 12 × 5)/4

⇒ r³ = 216

⇒ r = 6 cm

**∴ Radius of sphere is 6 cm**
